note: Triennial election of the rural district council, 1924: nominations received by William Calvert, deputy returning officer, 30 April 1924; polled 29 May 1924. No nominations for the Middletown and Derrynoose divisions. Returned unopposed. James Bell (U) withdrew his nomination (Belfast News-Letter, 8 May 1924, p. 5).
